title: Month, day, part of the day

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: When you add a month, go from the biggest time to the smallest: month, day, part of the day. *Júniusban szombaton délután a parkban sétálunk.* The month takes *-ban/-ben*, the day takes *-n/-on/-en/-ön*. To set two times against each other, use *nem … hanem*: *Nem hétfőn, hanem kedden tanulunk.*

sections.title: Month, day, part of the day
rows: In June, on Saturday, we walk.
In September, on Monday and Wednesday, we study.
In December, at the weekend, we rest at home.
We do sport not in January but in February.

items.english: In March, on Friday evening, we cook.
In July, at the weekend, we do sport in the park.
In October, on Thursday afternoon, we shop.
We study not on Tuesday but on Wednesday.

sections.content: Each word has its own ending: the month has *-ban/-ben*, the day has *-n*. Do not put a second ending on the same word.
